verdict.rationale: Ramp ships a Developer API (an OpenAPI spec with 174 paths) and documents several accounting touchpoints. The Banking API exposes a syncable-transactions endpoint for transactions bound for an accounting provider. The live MCP server lists accounting:read and accounting:write OAuth scopes, the Ramp CLI has an accounting resource, and agents can load accounting and tracking categories. However, no dedicated accounting endpoint set (GL accounts, sync management, coding rules) is explicitly documented in the Developer API reference. missing for 10: explicit Developer API accounting endpoints for reading and writing GL/coding data, accounting sync management via API, independent or hands-on corroboration
